gloss: Saint Giles (Aegidius) — Provençal hermit saint, popular Norman dedication

gloss: Saint Cuthbert — Northumbrian bishop, Lindisfarne / Durham dedications

gloss: Saint Bede — Northumbrian monk, Jarrow / Wearmouth dedications

gloss: Saint Aidan — Lindisfarne founder, Irish missionary to Northumbria

name: Wilfrid
gloss: Saint Wilfrid — 7th-c. Northumbrian bishop, Ripon / Hexham dedications

name: Werburgh
gloss: Saint Werburgh — Mercian abbess, Chester dedication

name: Edmund
gloss: Saint Edmund — East Anglian king-martyr (d. 869), Bury St Edmunds

name: Edward
gloss: Saint Edward the Confessor — late OE king, Westminster patron

name: Etheldreda
gloss: Saint Etheldreda (Audrey) — 7th-c. East Anglian princess-abbess, Ely founder

gloss: Saint Hilda — Whitby founder, presided over Synod of Whitby (664)

gloss: Saint Oswald — Northumbrian king-martyr (d. 642), widespread Mercian / Scots dedications

gloss: Saint John — Baptist or Evangelist, ubiquitous English dedication

gloss: Saint Paul — apostle, frequent paired with Peter in dedications

name: Andrew
gloss: Saint Andrew — apostle, Scottish national patron, common English dedication

name: Michael
gloss: Saint Michael — archangel, hilltop and high-place dedications

name: George
gloss: Saint George — patron of England post-Crusades, frequent later dedication

name: Bartholomew
gloss: Saint Bartholomew — apostle, London Smithfield + scattered dedications

name: Thomas
gloss: Saint Thomas (Becket) — Canterbury archbishop, popular post-1170 dedication

name: Margaret
gloss: Saint Margaret of Antioch — virgin-martyr, popular medieval dedication

gloss: Saint Augustine of Canterbury — Roman missionary (597), founder of Anglo-Saxon Church

gloss: Saint Lawrence — Roman deacon-martyr, widespread medieval dedication

name: Nicholas
gloss: Saint Nicholas of Myra — bishop, popular sailor / market dedications
